releases.notes: Native GDScript alpha: title-screen connection marker. Tests the separate Godot-native update channel; no mechanics or local save changes.

Four-stage native character creator: identity, abilities and skills, equipment, spellbook. Class-aware capped checkbox choices, racial bonuses, standard array and point buy, kit previews, portrait, character summary, fixed navigation. Centered settings and opaque input controls. Native mechanics unchanged; rolled attributes and gold purchase not yet ported.

Native gilded UI: gold vector end caps and padded buttons, compact cinematic menu, three-column character roster, styled input and journal panels, scrollable combat sidebar. Dedicated persistent pending-dice controls call the saved engine roll directly. Adds explicit target/weapon picker, unarmed attack rolls and limited approach movement. Existing creator, saves and release history retained. Windows execution not yet tested.

Expanded native port preview: distance-zone movement and opportunity attacks, short/long rests, Second Wind and limited Arcane Recovery, healing, area damage, Sleep, selected utility spells, upcasting and rituals with saved resolution, NPC role temperaments and relevant memory, recruitment and basic companion combat, spell/rest pickers, compact combat and campaign cards, dice animation, appearance settings, local DM guidance, diagnostics and copy-only compatible legacy import. Experimental: full 5e feature parity and Windows execution not yet verified.

Settings → DM prompts & content: editable shared DO/DON'T lists, Family/Standard/Mature narration profiles and per-layer guidance. Saves locally in dm_prompts.json, preserves existing guidance, applies on subsequent AI requests; native mechanics, provider safeguards and API configuration unchanged. Windows execution not yet tested.
